environment: Windows Editor batchmode, -nographics, no Console window rendering
messages: Identical prebuilt ASCII strings with unique six-digit sequence IDs; no interpolation in timed loops
unityRoute: UnityEngine.Debug.Log -> default DebugLogHandler -> per-process native Editor log
traceforgeRoute: TF.Info -> Logger -> single FileSink -> separate UTF-8 file; queueCapacity=4096
filters: Unity logEnabled=true/filterLogType=Log; TF global minimum=Info, no category overrides, exactly one FileSink
producerMetric: Stopwatch ticks around only the 100000 public logging calls on the main thread
completionMetric: TF producer+Flush is recorded separately; Unity equivalent is unavailable, not inferred from loop duration
persistence: After each process exits, check every warmup and measured sequence exactly once and in order in its actual output file
allocation: Main-thread GC.Alloc sample proxy with positive control and capacity/saturation recorded; not allocated bytes or worker allocations
stopRules: Stop on nonzero exit, timeout 300s, missing result, compilation diagnostic, disabled/wrong sink or capture/filter state, or missing/duplicate/out-of-order output. Preserve the attempt. No successful run or outlier is discarded.
analysis: Publish all five observations per mode and medians; producer median ratio and reduction only. A paired log-ratio t95 interval is descriptive with n=5 and approximate normal/independent-pair assumptions; it is not a new acceptance gate. If it spans parity, do not claim demonstrated superiority.
limits: Different output formatting and file paths, no Console GUI, no Player/mobile timing, no fsync guarantee. Default stack settings are not benchmarked.
existingPolicy: Historical reproduction FAIL and approved v0.3.0 rig exception, prior direct FileSink 5% gate, and scoped guard cost remain unchanged. No new baseline is adopted.
